VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 8, 2024

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called meeting to order at 5:03 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin

Commissioners Absent: Shaknovich

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also present: Christina Boatwright, Gus Orozco, Nick Sramek, Vic Hill, and Antawnette Blade.

Vice Chair Osborn led the Pledge of Allegiance.

1.  24-53294  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on

  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

2.  24-53295  Recommendation to receive and file the Chair’s Report for April 2024.

  Page 1 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES

  Chair suggested that various committees (comprising Commissioners and
  community members) such as an executive committee, legislative committee and
  homelessness task force be established.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Shaknovich

3.  24-53296  Recommendation to receive and file the Staff Report for April 2024.

  Commissioners reminded to attend Council meeting on 5/21 where staff will present
  on the Honoring Our Heroes Memorial Day event on 5/26. Veterans Commission
  Annual Report due on June 30. A brief survey will be sent out to all Commissioners
  to reflect on their work. Survey data will be included in the report. June 12 will be
  the last meeting for four Commissioners who are timing out (after serving four
  consecutive terms). Discussion around organizing a celebration for outgoing
  Commissioners followed.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Shaknovich

4.  24-53297  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners program.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Smith, seconded by Commissioner
  Antes, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Page 2 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 8, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Absent:  1 Shaknovich

  Banners are scheduled for installation on May 20. Options for promoting the
  banners may include a TFF (To/For/From) Memo informing Council and the Mayor
  that lists all 25 banner honorees and includes a link to their online bios, City social
  media posts, and informing the 25 families when the banners go up and their bios
  are posted on the DHHS site (Office of Veterans Support landign page).

5.  24-53298  Recommendation to discuss Honoring Our Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Contreras, to approve recommendation. The motion by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Shaknovich

  This year’s event will be larger with more to offer and more volunteers helping out.
  Event highlights include:

  · flyovers with historic aircraft
  · live patriotic music (with the Navy Band Southwest Harborside Brass Quintet)
  · exhibition drills (by Lakewood High School’s NJROTC)
  · an information fair with 11 local, historical, veteran-led and veteran-serving
  organizations participating
  · Kids Zone with a face painter and games
  · free hot dogs (courtesy of the Long Beach Fire Fighters Association
  · a brief program with a Navy officer (courtesy of Fleet Week), elected officials and
  keynote speaker Patricia Jackson-Kelley, USAF Lt. Colonel Retired
  · a sunset flag ceremony led by an Army Color Guard and concluding with the
  playing of Taps to honor our fallen service members

  Lead sponsor for the event is the Port of Long Beach. Long Beach Veterans Day
  Committee is also a partner, and event emcee is our very own Smitty.

  Commissioners were reminded to volunteer for set-up, clean-up, staffing the OVS
  booth and more. They were also reminded to reach out to their respective
  Councilmembers about their participation and to promote the event far and wide.
  Flyers will be available for pick up and distribution (at the VA Long Beach, Century
  Villages at Cabrillo and other locations) starting next week and social media
  graphics will also be shared.

6.  24-53299  Recommendation to discuss budget request for FY 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osborn, seconded by Commissioner
  Antes, Substitute Motion – Recommendation to table this item pending
  further discussion . The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith, Goodin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Shaknovich

  The Commission discussed a strategic approach to such a request that reflects
  research (on other Commission’s budgets, for example), experience, and
  constructive input (some Commissioners have extensive experience with creating
  budgets and asking for support).

PUBLIC COMMENT

Gus Orozco commented on Honoring Our Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony and his organization’s
involvement with planning and supporting the event. (the Long Beach Veterans Day Committee).

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Long Beach Pride Parade on May 19: a VA contingent will be marching and Commissioners are
invited to join, Commissioner Osborn has full details. Memorial Day Commemoration event at
American Gold Star Manor on Friday, May 24.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:45.
